{{BadmintonAt1992SummerOlympics}}
The winner of the women's singles competition received the first official badminton medal in Olympic history.  It was also the first [[gold medal]] for [[Indonesia]], which before had only won one silver (in [[archery]]).  52 players from 27 nations competed in women's singles.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.olympedia.org/results/42107 |title=Badminton at the 1992 Summer Olympics: Singles, Women |work=Olympedia |accessdate=27 May 2020}}</ref>
